title: Three Essays on High School Social Studies Coursetaking
summary_en: The author explores which students take which courses and why; the extent to which state and local policy mechanisms shape enrollment patterns; and the extent to which students’ coursetaking matters for their college, career, and civic outcomes.
title_cn: Three Essays on High School Social Studies Coursetaking

title: Three Essays on Artificial Intelligence and Work in the U.S.
summary_en: The arrival of artificial intelligence (AI) in workplaces worldwide has raised concerns about the implications for workers. The author examines the relationship between AI and work in the United States through quantitative and qualitative lenses.
title_cn: Three Essays on Artificial Intelligence and Work in the U.S.
